description: Reported the socket, the loaf, and the wool left in the saucer.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Counted three, gave them more sense than him, and sent him out with a clear plate.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Reached for the saucer and was told off.
name: Gib

description: Wrote the two pence and shut the book.
name: William Shakespeare
